prompt_text: A very wide, straight highway under a clear blue sky, with dark roadside barriers, green grass, and long rows of tall trees on both sides. The road begins abruptly at a starting point, with no ground behind it—only open sky, as if the road is suspended in space. A yellow sports car with two black racing stripes is parking exactly at the start of the road, centered in the frame, viewed from behind. The car faces forward into the long empty highway. Bright daytime lighting, clean and minimal environment. The character is the yellow sports car

rubric_items.rubric_text: Does the environment consistently show a very wide, straight highway extending forward across all sampled frames?
Does the sky stay clear blue across all sampled frames?
Do both sides of the highway consistently show dark roadside barriers, green grass, and long rows of tall trees across all sampled frames?
Across all sampled frames, does the road begin abruptly with no ground behind it, showing only open sky as if suspended in space?
Does the environment consistently maintain bright daytime lighting and a clean, minimal look across all sampled frames?
When the main vehicle is visible and judgeable, is it clearly a sports car rather than another type of vehicle?
When the car is visible and judgeable, is its body predominantly yellow as specified in the prompt?
When the car is visible and judgeable, are there exactly two black racing stripes on it?
